description: Directory of local help for a welcome desk, library or club: places grouped by kind (food pantries, free meals, medical rides, shelters, utility help), with address, phone, structured open days plus times, and a last-checked date that flags stale hours. Can print one page per kind of help. An organization can start with its own list (no practice banner) by setting window.DirectorySeed. Volunteers add and edit places themselves and print a one-page list; a type-ahead search understands 'food tuesday'; a map view shows numbered pins fully offline (optional street map when online; addresses looked up once on save, or tap to place). Backup/restore, spreadsheet export, works offline. Stores only public place details, never visitor information. Start fresh also clears the practice name, printout note and map centre (kept if the charity changed them), with one undo.

config_schema.org: string, name shown at top and on the printout (edited inside the app)
config_schema.deskNote: string, note at the bottom of the printout (edited inside the app)
config_schema.staleDays: number, ask people to call first when last checked longer ago than this (default 90)
config_schema.tiles: boolean, show street map behind pins when online (default true)
config_schema.categories: optional in the data: [{id,label,color,words}] to replace the default kinds of help
config_schema.printPerKind: boolean, print each kind of help on its own page (default false; edited in More)
config_schema.DirectorySeed (build time): optional config.js run before the app: window.DirectorySeed = {places:[...], categories?:[...], settings?:{org, deskNote, center, printPerKind}}. Used as the first-run list instead of practice data.
config_schema.schemaVersion: number in saved data and backups, 1 (missing counts as 1); older data is upgraded on load
